sentence: In the first case, competitive advantage appears as a construct of its own, defined against other organizations in the same market and tested as a separate hypothesis

gemini.note: The passage defines competitive advantage relatively against other organizations in similar conditions and explicitly frames it within a separate hypothesis (H4).
